long_summary: Authenticate to Azure and persist account context for subsequent commands.

examples.short_summary: Login with a user-assigned managed identity
Login with a managed identity using short flags
Login with a service principal using a secret

parameters.name: --client-id
parameters.short_summary: Client ID of the user-assigned managed identity, or the application ID when used with --service-principal.

parameters.name: --client-secret
parameters.short_summary: Client secret for the service principal.

parameters.name: --federated-token
parameters.short_summary: Federated token issued by a trusted external identity provider. The issuer and subject must be configured as a federated credential on the application.

parameters.name: --identity
parameters.short_summary: Login using managed identity in the current environment.

parameters.name: --object-id
parameters.short_summary: Object ID of the user-assigned managed identity.

parameters.name: --out-profile
parameters.short_summary: Create or overwrite a named profile with the login result (mutually exclusive with --profile).

parameters.name: --profile
parameters.short_summary: Re-authenticate the named existing profile (mutually exclusive with --out-profile).

parameters.name: --resource-id
parameters.short_summary: Resource ID of the user-assigned managed identity.

parameters.name: --service-principal
parameters.short_summary: Login as a service principal using a federated (OIDC) token.

parameters.name: --subscription-id
parameters.short_summary: Optional Azure subscription ID. Omit for tenant-only sign-in.

parameters.name: --use-device-code
parameters.short_summary: Use device code flow for authentication.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.short_summary: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help -h -help -? --?
parameters.short_summary: Show help for the command or group and exit.

parameters.name: --no-cache
parameters.short_summary: Bypass the extension discovery cache and reload extensions from disk.

parameters.name: --output -o
parameters.choices: json, jsonc, table, tsv, yaml, yamlc

parameters.name: --query
parameters.short_summary: JMESPath query string to filter/project the command result before rendering.
